argv:
set -eu
test "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = 49453863-ac70-46cb-9f29-41dfaa118329
test "$(stat -c '%d:%i:%s' /installed.qcow2)" = 64785:138422282:2644508672
echo 'e235a3bbfdff9e5b4c364bf46757a0975265ff4ea52c95d891238b4be36813dc  /firmware.bin' | sha256sum -c -
echo '1d5d578dd82a402be1a56d1eb52b29d59e50e7c4674a571a0ac4e3505e3e5abe  /usr/bin/qemu-system-sparc64' | sha256sum -c -
/usr/bin/qemu-system-sparc64 --version
exec /usr/bin/qemu-system-sparc64 -M sun4u -m 1088 -smp 1 -boot c -vga none -bios /firmware.bin -drive file=/installed.qcow2,if=ide,index=0,format=qcow2,file.locking=on -global cmd646-ide.x-b134-status-compat=on -prom-env input-device=ttya -prom-env output-device=ttya -prom-env 'auto-boot?=false' -display none -monitor unix:/run/sun4u/monitor.sock,server=on,wait=off -gdb unix:/run/sun4u/debug.sock,server=on,wait=off -chardev socket,id=owner_serial,path=/run/sun4u/serial.sock,server=on,wait=off,logfile=/run/sun4u/serial.log,logappend=on -serial chardev:owner_serial
